title: THE DRIVE TO BIGGER AI MODELS
extracted_text:
The scale of artificial-intelligence neural networks is growing exponentially, as measured by the models' parameters (roughly, the number of connections between their neurons)*.

*Sparse' models, which have more than one trillion parameters but use only a fraction of them in each computation, are not shown.
diagram_summary: Scatter plot showing the exponential growth of AI model parameters from 1950 to 2020, categorized by application type (Language, Image generation, Vision, Other).
diagram_elements: Y-axis: Number of parameters (log scale) from 10 to 1 trillion
